unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Color filters
drDigitalIntro:
About one man in twelve finds certain color pairs hard to tell apart — most often red and green.
• A color filter changes how the computer shows color so those pairs stop clashing.
• Grayscale removes color entirely: everything becomes shades of gray. Nothing depends on hue anymore.
• Warm shifts the whole screen toward orange, which some people find easier on the eyes at night.
• Off is the third choice, and it is where you started.

playgroundTask.goal: You switched the screen to grayscale

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Under Color Filters, click the Grayscale button.

drDigitalSuccess: All the color drained out. Look at the dock — the app tiles are now told apart by their shapes, not their colors.
drDigitalHint: Color Filters is the row of three buttons at the bottom of the Color and Contrast card.
